nodes.title: Stuart Hall Celebrity Face Mask Fancy Dress Cardboard Costume Mask
nodes.descriptionHtml:
Turn heads at a birthday roast with a Stuart Hall face mask that's made for photos, laughs and a bit of mischief. It's a firm favourite with comedy fans, and it travels flat in an envelope so it's easy to post as a gift.

Stuart Hall Card Face Mask for Parties

We print this comedian mask in full colour on thick 350gsm silk card, cut it to the shape of the face and pre-cut the eye holes. Elastic and sticky tabs are included. Want a mask of someone who isn't in our range, like the birthday boy or the bride-to-be? We can make one from your photo.

Why you'll love it

  • An easy, cheap way to theme a birthday roast
  • Brilliant for photo booths and group shots
  • Thick 350gsm silk card holds its shape all night
  • Semi-waterproof finish, so it copes with spilt drinks and outdoor parties
  • Pre-cut eye holes, with elastic and sticky tabs included

Size & details

  • Size: 297 x 210 mm (A4), a full adult-size face
  • Material: 350gsm silk card, full-colour digital print
  • Finish: semi-waterproof
  • Fit: one size for adults; elastic and sticky tabs included
  • Pre-cut eye holes; cut to the shape of the face
  • Packaging: board-backed envelope

Delivery

Printed in our UK workshop and posted to you. Dispatch and postage options are shown at checkout.

A Stuart Hall face mask is a cheap and cheerful way to make a comedy night one to remember.

Please note

This is an unofficial novelty product made for fun and fancy dress. Stuart Hall has not endorsed, sponsored or approved this product, and Foxy Printing has no connection with them. The name is used only to describe the design.

seo.description: Get the party started with a Stuart Hall face mask. Full-colour print on 350gsm card, cut to shape with elastic. Great for a birthday roast.
